title: WYNONNA JUDD – The Hard Truth Tour
seo_title: Wynonna Judd – The Hard Truth Tour Live Concert
description: This is a live concert by country music artist Wynonna Judd on her Hard Truth Tour, where you watch her perform her music on stage. She first rose to fame with her mother, Naomi, as one half of The Judds, with eight consecutive No. 1 hits before a solo career, and The Hard Truth features some of her most personal work yet. Tickets should be bought only from HammonsHall.com or MissouriStateTix.com, the official ticket sources.
venue: Juanita K. Hammons Hall for the Performing Arts
